Capability: Runs the linear-static preview solve: validates and normalizes a preview model, builds the frame model, assembles stiffness, solves each load case and returns one mechanics envelope.
Notes: Single large adapter file over the code-neutral solver, load and unit crates. Reached from the desktop native solve commands and the headless runner. Stages stop at the first blocking diagnostic.

Capability: Defines the preview model and solve request wire shape (project, nodes, pipes, sections, components, supports, load cases, loads, combinations, materials) for deserialization.
Notes: The request materials list overrides model materials when non-empty. Document kind and schema version are checked at solve entry.

Capability: Defines the mechanics result envelope: separate status boundaries, located result items with basis and sign-convention metadata, diagnostics and a no-professional-claim boundary.
Notes: Blocked envelopes carry diagnostics and no solved rows.

Capability: Blocks a preview solve before mechanics when required collections, identifiers, provenance, units, hanger, component, thermal or combination inputs are missing or invalid.
Notes: Validation rule family emitting coded blocking diagnostics. Component checks cover bend, branch, rigid and expansion-joint geometry, mapping and modifier fields.

Capability: Normalizes authored coordinates and quantities to canonical units at the mechanics boundary and blocks missing, unknown or dimensionally incompatible units.
Resolves pipe references to shared section definitions and blocks stale, blank or failed references while keeping local section inputs.
Notes: Cached section copies must match the referenced definition exactly.

Capability: Derives pipe section properties and mass per length from diameter and wall, reducing the wall by a user mill tolerance when present.
Notes: No default tolerance is applied.

Capability: Maps supports to rigid per-DOF restraints and springs by family (anchor, guide, line stop, vertical, spring) and blocks unknown family tokens or fewer than six ground DOFs.
Notes: The six-DOF count is a necessary lower bound only; the assembled solve decides stability. No automatic boundary conditions are added.

Capability: Solves gap, lift-off, friction and contact supports through an iterative active-set loop and reports support states, residual observations and convergence evidence.
Notes: Loop limits and residual tolerances are fixed in-file constants; several limits are zero or provisional observation thresholds.

Capability: Supplies the friction normal reaction either from an explicit user value or derived from a named support reaction and reports it as separate evidence.
Notes: Friction normal evidence is excluded from load combinations.

Capability: Lets the caller choose a sparse interactive or dense scrutiny linear solve and records solver-mode, sparse live-path and parity evidence with fallback diagnostics.
Notes: Sparse interactive is the default. The mode reaches users through the desktop solver-mode solve commands.

Capability: Converts authored primitive loads (nodal forces and moments, full and partial-span uniform loads, global or local directions) into element and nodal mechanics loads.
Applies thermal expansion as equivalent element loads with fixed-end axial correction, requiring an explicit material expansion coefficient.
Notes: Authored thermal load direction does not affect magnitude or sign.

Capability: Applies internal pressure thrust as axial element loads from genuine pressure records only, summing multiple records once and ignoring hydrotest-dimension records.
Generates seismic and wind equivalent-static distributed or nodal loads from user gravity, density, factors and marked exposed spans, blocking when inputs are missing or overlap.
Notes: No default gravity or environmental values. Sub-span wind is not allowed on curved-bend macro spans.

Capability: Selects material modulus, shear modulus and expansion per load case from an exact user temperature point or by interpolating a declared temperature, recording provenance.
Notes: Each distinct basis gets its own assembled stiffness. No extrapolation or silent fallback to base properties when a basis is named.

Capability: Reports signed global node displacement and rotation components and displacement magnitudes per load case.
Recovers element end forces and section resultants at endpoints and interior stations with stated sign conventions and piecewise extrema.
Recovers endpoint and station stress components and an open-formula stress summary from section resultants and pressure without code criteria.
Notes: No allowables or acceptance checks are applied.

Capability: Applies user-entered bend and branch stress multipliers to recovered stresses and emits side-specific stress review rows.
Notes: Multipliers come only from user input; no built-in factor tables.

Capability: Models expansion joints as user-stiffness macro elements and applies user effective-area pressure thrust, emitting review rows.
Models bends as curved-arc macro elements with arc stiffness, arc-consistent weight, thermal and pressure loads, arc station results and nonlinear-loop support.
Notes: Selected per component by a solver-consumption token; the older chord realization is retained when not selected.

Capability: Requires explicit variable spring hanger stiffness and emits hanger input review rows without catalog defaults.
Applies a user-entered constant-effort support force on its declared translational DOF in every load case with zero stiffness, warning for non-consuming shapes.
Notes: No gravity coupling, catalog value or inferred direction.

Capability: Evaluates explicit load combinations (factored linear, result-state subtraction, range envelopes) over solved rows, including combined vector magnitudes.
Notes: Stress summary rows are excluded from combination with diagnostics.

Capability: Maps solver kernel diagnostics into product diagnostics and fails closed without solved rows on singular, non-finite or blocked solves.
Exposes the preview solver's crate name and version and passes through the nonlinear loop's identity, assumptions and limitations for result producers.
Notes: Consumed by the headless runner result binding and the desktop report-package bridge.

Capability: Plans self-weight load operations for selected pipes from section, material and optional mass inputs and a signed gravity axis, failing without a partial plan.
Notes: Produces operation drafts bound to a source model hash; the caller applies them. Reached through a WASM wrapper and a desktop native command.

Capability: Computes exact thick-walled annulus pressure mechanics (radial and hoop stress distribution, axial states, local element pairs) with scaled arithmetic against underflow.
Notes: Dormant: private module marked dead code and not called by assembly, solve, recovery or serialization.

Capability: Developer example that solves the invented preview fixture and prints the mechanics envelope as JSON.
Notes: Cargo example; no product path.

Capability: Validates the bounded preview model shape in Python (document kind, geometry, identity and provenance, combination terms, references) and blocks prohibited claim text.
Notes: Python counterpart to part of the Rust validation; no product caller found outside tests and a witness input generator.

Capability: Returns a preview mechanics envelope and an immutable analysis-run record built from a stored invented result fixture plus model validation diagnostics.
Notes: Does not solve: result values come from a fixture file regardless of the input model.

Capability: Materializes a read-only report-packet context with result, run and proposal references, hashes, privacy and professional boundaries.
Notes: Explicitly not a rendered report or export payload.

Capability: Builds model-tree inspector records and returns invented design-knowledge and a non-mutating agent proposal preview.
Notes: Fixture-backed; proposals are never applied.

Capability: Derives a solver-oriented centerline analytical model from a physical source model, with traceability links and diagnostics instead of inferred defaults.
Notes: Source model is never mutated; unsupported records are omitted with diagnostics. Only tests call it; a handoff exporter cites the file path as a contract reference.

Capability: Adapts a canonical analytical model into deterministic solver-boundary records for nodes, straight pipes, property bindings, supports and load cases, with hashed identities.
Notes: Internal module; no product caller found. The preview solve path does not use it.

Capability: Validates headless runner request and result records (operation, references, privacy, professional boundary, open decisions, result-envelope checksum).
Runs the preview solve in memory for a runner request, producing deterministic run references and mapping a rule-check aggregate into the analysis status.
Notes: Unrecognized rule-check statuses block rather than coerce.

Capability: Builds a canonical result-export document from a solved run only when opaque evidence proves the exact solved payload, otherwise reports export unavailable.
Notes: Library surface only; excluded from serialized runner output. Typed legacy callers always get unavailable.

Capability: Gates runner output that may carry local-private data, withholding payloads unless explicit local-private intent is given and reporting redaction findings.
Notes: Intent inside the source payload is not trusted; binaries decide whether to print or write.

Capability: Provides the local openpipestress-runner CLI with solve, validate-input, export-results, run-benchmark and run-regression verbs, JSON input and output and exit codes.
Notes: Foreground local process only; no network or daemon. Exit 0 clean, 1 blocking, 2 usage or input error.

Capability: Exports a report package from the runner by validating bindings to the linked solver identity and writing only the named output after local-private intent.
Notes: Uses the report-package wire assembler with the preview solver's name and version.

Capability: Runs named or whole mechanics, stress and nonlinear benchmark and regression cases and compares observations with recorded suite values, failing closed on gaps.
Notes: Reuses the suite crates' own comparison predicates; adds no tolerance. Results are regression evidence only.

Capability: Provides a compatibility preview-runner binary that solves a named model fixture with a built-in request and prints controlled JSON output.
Notes: Marked provisional; retained alongside the stable CLI.
